findings.description: The expense total is the sum of all listed amounts except the last row. On the unfiltered list the rows sum to $399.99 but the total shows $306.74 (the last row, Project dinner $93.25, is left out). The same off-by-one appears under category filters (travel shows $61.25 instead of $185.25; meals shows $84.00 instead of $177.25; office shows $12.99 instead of $37.49) and for the editor after an add or edit.
repro: Sign in as viewer-788e at /login and open /expenses.
Add the amounts of all rows in the table: they sum to $399.99.
Read the total: 'Total: $306.74'. The last row's $93.25 is not included.
Choose category 'travel' and Apply: the rows are $42.50, $18.75 and $124.00 (sum $185.25), but the total reads $61.25.

notes: Tested as editor and viewer. Filter results are correct. Add expense works: the success message shows, exactly one row is added, and it survives a reload, though the total still omits the last row. Edit works: the new amount appears in the list and total straight away, and persists after reload. Viewer sees no add or edit controls. Direct GET /expenses/new and /expenses/1/edit return 403 to the viewer, and direct POST to /expenses, /expenses/1 and /expenses/1/delete return 403 with no change to data. Page loads were about 24 ms. Test data was changed: a row 'QA Test Taxi' ($10.00) was added and 'Team lunch' was changed from $68.40 to $75.00.
